method: Analytic ellipsoidal cup walls, finite rolled annulus, two explicit point pole triangle fans
section_tangent_joins: Outer/inner cup at t=0 and annular rim at phi=0/pi all axial tangent; curvature may change at real rolled rim transition
pole_regularization: Transverse shape perturbation fades to zero as cos(t)^2; no angular square singularity at poles
